children: will be reporting results this Monday after market close. Here’s what investors should know.

AECOM missed analysts’ revenue expectations last quarter, reporting revenues of $3.59 billion, down 14.2% year on year. It was an underwhelming quarter for the company, with full-year EBITDA guidance missing analysts’ expectations significantly and a significant miss of analysts’ EBITDA estimates.
Is AECOM a buy or sell going into earnings?

params.linkText: Read our full analysis here, it’s free for active Edge members

children: This quarter, the market is expecting AECOM’s revenue to decline 4% year on year, a reversal from the 1.6% increase it recorded in the same quarter last year.
Analysts covering the company have generally reconfirmed their estimates over the last 30 days, suggesting they anticipate the business will stay the course heading into earnings.

Looking at AECOM’s peers in the engineering and design services segment, some have already reported their Q3 results, giving us a hint as to what we can expect. EMCOR delivered year-on-year revenue growth of 28.8%, beating analysts’ expectations by 6.3%, and Sterling reported revenues up 127%, topping estimates by 31.4%. EMCOR’s stock price was unchanged after the resultswhile Sterling was down 3.9%.

There has been positive sentiment among investors in the engineering and design services segment, with share prices up 2.5% on average over the last month. AECOM is up 19.7% during the same time and is heading into earnings with an average analyst price target of $83.92 (compared to the current share price of $69.98).

title: AECOM reports earnings tomorrow: What to expect
